speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis. The chest X-ray findings of bilateral interstitial infiltrates are classic for this condition, and in the absence of other acute causes like pneumonia or heart failure, this is the most likely diagnosis. I recommend we proceed with a high-resolution CT scan and pulmonary function tests to confirm the diagnosis and assess the extent of lung damage.
